name: Fathom Analytics
description: Fathom Analytics is a privacy-focused web analytics platform positioned as a simple, fast alternative to Google Analytics that protects visitor privacy without sacrificing actionable insights.
best_for: Developers and technical teams seeking straightforward analytics, privacy-conscious businesses and creators, and companies wanting faster site performance, including customers like IBM, GitHub, and Bootstrap.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Lowest paid tier. Annual billing gets two months free (about 17% off); monthly billing is also available, so annual is not required.

cons: No free plan at all — the pricing page states directly that subscription fees pay for running and improving Fathom, with no permanent free tier.
The 7-day free trial requires a credit card upfront and auto-bills when the trial ends, so it isn't a no-risk trial.

Pricing is a strict step-ladder by pageview cap rather than metered billing — going even one pageview over a tier's limit pushes the whole account to the next, more expensive tier, and above 25 million pageviews/month there's no published price at all.
features: Event tracking for custom interactions like sign-ups, clicks, and ecommerce transactions
Real-time dashboard powered by a lightweight, 2kB script
Automated email reports on a weekly or monthly cadence
UTM-based campaign and newsletter performance tracking
Perpetual data retention with unlimited historical access
Bot detection to filter spam and scraper traffic
Developer-friendly API integrating with any CMS or framework, with no cookie consent banners required

alternatives.name: Plausible Analytics
alternatives.description: A privacy-focused, cookieless web analytics platform with funnels, goals, and SEO-focused features.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting cookieless analytics with built-in funnel and campaign tracking.

alternatives.name: Google Analytics
alternatives.description: A free analytics tool from Google measuring customer behavior across websites and apps.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting free, easy measurement unified with Google's ad platforms.

alternatives.name: Matomo
alternatives.description: Privacy-first analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in.
